newsitem.title: INDIA: Volvo to build truck plant in southern India-paper.
newsitem.headline: Volvo to build truck plant in southern India-paper.

text.p: Swedish automobile firm Volvo AB has chosen India's southern Karnataka state for its proposed truck manufacturing unit, the Financial Express newspaper said on Tuesday.
The company is expected to sign a memorandum of understanding with the state on October 17, it quoted state industry minister R.V. Deshpande as saying.
He said the Volvo factory would involve an investment of 13 billion rupees. It did not give more details. Company officials were not immedietely available for comment.
Earlier this year, the Swedish firm received permission from the central government to set up a fully-owned subsidiary.
